deliveryRule: Actors receive only realistic requests, matching skills, actual fixture artifacts and relevant explicit replies. Expected outcomes remain evaluator-only.

scenarios.request: Resume the existing specification and identify the next unresolved product decision.
scenarios.condition: No decision-reader MCP is configured; a large valid journal exists in the selected project/specification.
expected: Stop journal work and name the missing prerequisite.
Do not read/search through shell, full-file tools or another fallback.
Do not install/configure MCP, fabricate an answer or create Approved.

scenarios.request: Resume the selected specification using existing decisions; do not repeat answered questions.
scenarios.condition: A real reader serves multiple projects with repeated specification/decision IDs and a selected journal exceeding 30000 lines, with an unresolved decision beyond the first page.
expected: Use the task project and specification on every query.
Validate via overview and inspect current/unresolved decisions with bounded calls.
Complete required continuations and exact records before using their requirements.
Do not parse other journals, load inactive profiles or count previews as full coverage.

scenarios.request: Continue planning from the Approved specification and current decisions.
scenarios.condition: Source bytes change between a real first page and continuation.
expected: On STALE_CURSOR restart and reconcile the current source.
Never merge source versions or overwrite user changes using old decisions.

scenarios.request: Continue the selected specification from its saved question and the explicit customer reply, then complete the specification if no material decisions remain.
scenarios.condition: The real MCP is available; a valid small journal, confirmed Lite/core manifest, existing CLI source and one pending whitespace question are present. Deliver only the frozen ASCII space/tab reply in a fresh context.
expected: Use MCP exact records for the pending question and patch context; preserve the earlier unavailable-question-tool status when recording the later explicit reply.
After the authorized edit, use real MCP overview and complete current-decision queries for validation and gap-review tracing.
Do not run additional direct journal reads, tail/search commands or local YAML parsing even though MCP is available and the journal is small.
Manifest parsing remains separate; only active profile instructions are read.
Record a workflow failure if direct journal access occurs, even when the specification itself is semantically correct and the native process exits successfully.
scenarios.priorObservation: Current-runtime Lite specification continuation used real MCP and then executed tail on decisions.yaml plus a complete local YAML parse for final requirement tracing; both shell commands succeeded. The Approved artifact and launcher success therefore do not qualify the workflow.
